# M0-a-13 — closing check of the consolidation round R10 (lane check/M0-a-13-consolidate-close-1, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-10-12)

Lane `check/M0-a-13-consolidate-close-1`. The checker is Opus 5.5 in Claude Code, running in a Claude Code cloud container
(Linux x64, Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, 4 cpu, 16 GiB, Node v24.12.0). `tools/machine_profile.py --id` printed
`linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz:4cpu:16gib`. The checker is an independent, implementer-side closing
checker. It is not the round's author (`build/M0-a-13-consolidate-1`, L-0465) and not an earlier checker of the item. Its
ledger row is **L-0466**. Under J269 this verdict goes to this file; `checks/M0-a-13.md` stays as committed.

The seat ran no git command and changed no item file. It read the git index's blob hashes from `.git/index` as a file
(see "Before-image"). It planned its probes and mutants from the brief, the plan and the code before it read the
author's notes and C-0334. Every probe and mutant ran in its own mirror
`scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-13/`. The gates ran on the shared tree. Every vitest run used the worker count of
`tools/test_budget.py`, which printed 1 throughout, with no `--` before a vitest flag (J182).

## Verdict: PASS

Every failing line of the brief is fixed: W-1, W-2, W-3, W-4 (reported and kept), W-5, W-6, W-S1, the comment rewrite
and NO-SHIFT. Every gate in scope is green, apart from RELATED's one foreign red: a testkit edge pin that is red identically with the
before-image's warp (N-r10-3). The check found no blocker.
Eight minor notes, N-r10c-1 – N-r10c-8, are appended to `checks/M0-a-13-notes.md`.

## Before-image (how the checker obtained it without git)

The checker rebuilt the round's before-image from the mirror `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-01/m1/plat`, taken on
2026-10-12 at 05:18, before R10. The before-image of `src/warp/{held,index,simplify,validate,view,warp,smooth,types}.ts`
and `test/warp/{validate,fixtures}.test.ts` is that mirror's copy of each file. Each file's git blob sha1 equals the git
index's entry for the same path, which is HEAD's, since R10 is uncommitted. For example, `warp.ts` is `a12888b0…`,
`validate.ts` is `dc3cb91a…` and `index.ts` is `ed7770df…` (read by a Python parser of `.git/index`). The mirror's
`src/warp` and `test/warp` differ from the tree in exactly the seven files the landed record names as changed by R10.
The checker built two mirrors, `before/` and `after/`. `after/` is the tree as it stands. `before/` is the same tree with
those seven files put back.

## (3) New findings

There is no blocker. Every gate is green apart from RELATED's foreign red. The interfaces (`warp`, `MoveReport`,
`DisplacementField`, `heldSet`, `simplify`, `smoothCommitted`) and every listed test title are present, and the exported
names are unchanged. No stub, TODO or skip was found: the grep is empty. No path lies outside plat/, and there is no
clean-room breach.

**Mutants.** The checker planned and ran 30 targeted mutants, one at a time, in its mirror `mut/`. Each was first run
over `test/warp` at fuzz size 10³. Each survivor was then re-run over `test/warp` at 10⁴ and over test/num,
test/invariants and testkit's constructive tests at 10³ (layout's simplify users for simplify's mutants, test/skeleton
for exact.ts's half-plane).

- **Killed, 22:** W1a, W1b, W1c, W1d, W2a, W2b, W2d, W2e, W3-K08, W3b, W4d, W6c, WS1b, N3a, N3c, N3d, N3e, U-M01, U-K12,
  U-K19, U-M19, U-K16.
- **Equivalent, 4** (N-r10c-5): W4c, WS1a, W6a, W6b.
- **Not equivalent, surviving, 4:** W2c (N-r10c-3), W4a (N-r10c-4), W4b (N-r10c-1) and N3b (N-r10c-2).
  - All four mutate behaviour that the round left unchanged; the NO-SHIFT logs show it unchanged.
  - Three of them (W2c, W4a, W4b) mutate placeOnRoute's own loop, whose body the round did not touch. Round 1's M34
    tie-break survivor was likewise a note.
  - The code is right on the inputs that separate each mutant: the per-call charges are in the identical logs, and probe
    P-N3b gives null on the code and a red under N3b.
  - Under FAIL SAFE NOW (N-45), each is a further hardening test, recorded as a note row for M4, not a fail.

**Refusals (J264, J290)** in the item's families are the same before and after, measured from the NO-SHIFT logs:

- **B-FUZZ warp:** 0 of 2 × 10 002 cases.
- **Invariants warp steps:** 0 of 100.
- **testkit constructive:** 0 of 67.

  - 1 assertion: a fromLevel other than the batch's. This is a programming error, not a refusal.
